name: Rieder Stub´n
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Rieder Stub’n in Ried im Oberinntal!**

Nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, this cozy mountain inn invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality. Savor traditional dishes like hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, crispy **Speckknödel**, and tender **Tiroler Gröstl**, all crafted with local ingredients.

After a delicious meal, warm up by the crackling fireplace with a glass of **Tiroler Apfelstrudelwein** or a frothy **Tiroler Bier**. The rustic charm of the **Stub’n** makes it the perfect retreat after a day of hiking in the **Lechtal Alps** or exploring the scenic **Oberinntal**.

Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, **Rieder Stub’n** promises unforgettable moments in one of **Tirol**’s most picturesque regions. **Willkommen in Tirol!**
